command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== verify staged input sha256 (same bytes the mafft recipe aligns) =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 3adadccdf1c0af2d2931b7d6dae68355c4df5ac2cff3905cb5c251bf1d78d43f unaligned.fa > pin.sha256
sha256sum -c pin.sha256
echo "== muscle v5 align =="
muscle -align unaligned.fa -output aln.fa 2> muscle.log
# Do NOT rm unaligned.fa: it is a staged input owned by the instance user; on host /tmp
# (sticky 1777) the container gets EPERM unlinking it and `rm -f` does not suppress EPERM.
# ---- smoke check: RESIDUE CONSERVATION (exact-or-wrong, method-independent) ----
# An aligner may only insert gap columns; ungapping every aligned row must reproduce the
# exact input sequence. Cross-code agreement with mafft is a DIFFERENT question (two MSAs
# differ by design) and is checked downstream via tree topology -- see recipes/nf-spawn.
awk '
FNR==1{fn++}
/^>/{id=substr($1,2); if(fn==1){uord[++nu]=id} else {aord[++na]=id}; cur=id; next}
{ if(fn==1){U[cur]=U[cur] $0} else {A[cur]=A[cur] $0} }
END{
  fail=0; maxin=0
  for(i=1;i<=nu;i++){ if(length(U[uord[i]])>maxin) maxin=length(U[uord[i]]) }
  alnlen=-1; totres=0
  for(i=1;i<=na;i++){ id=aord[i]; a=A[id]
    if(alnlen==-1) alnlen=length(a); else if(length(a)!=alnlen){print "FAIL non-rectangular "id; fail=1}
    g=a; gsub(/[-.]/,"",g)
    if(!(id in U)){print "FAIL id-not-in-input "id; fail=1; continue}
    if(g!=U[id]){print "FAIL residues-differ "id; fail=1}
    totres+=length(g)
  }
  printf "nseqs                    %d   want exactly 114\n", na          > "smoke-check.txt"
  printf "aln_len                  %d  want >= %d (longest input)\n", alnlen, maxin >> "smoke-check.txt"
  printf "total_ungapped_residues  %d   want exactly 49098 (residue conservation)\n", totres >> "smoke-check.txt"
  if(na!=114) fail=1
  if(alnlen<maxin) fail=1
  if(totres!=49098) fail=1
  if(fail){ print "residue conservation broken" > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1 }
}
' unaligned.fa aln.fa
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
